title: Contextual Network Pathfinder and Cost Annotations for Private Clusters
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, contextual 'Pathfinder' overlay for Private/VPC cluster pages that visualizes the active network path for a tenant (ingress -> egress -> peer links) and surfaces per-hop cost annotations and risk indicators. The feature helps operators and SREs quickly correlate networking topology changes to cost deltas and rollout/upgrade impacts without leaving the cluster detail view.
acceptance_criteria: Clickable Pathfinder overlay renders for clusters with >1 network hop and matches topology from infra API
Cost annotations show last-7-day incremental cost per hop and link to cost-breakdown drill-in
Risk indicators reflect current health and historical degradation (green/amber/red) and map to the incident playbook
Prototype validated in usability study with at least 6 platform engineers and time-to-diagnosis improved vs baseline
Handoff includes annotated Figma frames, interaction spec, and a component token list for engineering
comments: 2026-02-18 Maya Chen: Initial UX brief created after sync with PM (Arjun). Goal: reduce friction when debugging private cluster network/cost issues.

2026-02-25 Arjun Patel (PM): Requested explicit 'cost delta' tooltip and link to billing dashboard; noted this must be hideable for SOC customers.
2026-02-28 Leah Ortiz: Usability sessions scheduled with infra SREs (6 participants). Updated prototype to include hop collapse and quick-filter.
2026-03-03 Design review: UX team feedback - prefer inline microcopy for 'estimated' vs 'actual' cost; engineering raised telemetry gaps for per-hop metrics (ENG-39310).
2026-03-03 Leah Ortiz: Submitted design spec to Confluence and created GH stub PR with component tokens (see links).
review_feedback: PM Arjun: Make the cost numbers secondary by default; primary focus should be path correctness and triage affordances.
Eng Nick R.: Need a fallback when per-hop telemetry is missing; show 'estimated' label and include link to telemetry backlog (ENG-39310).
Security Priya: Ensure the overlay respects cluster RBAC; do not expose tenant IDs in shared views by default.
Design Lead Sam: Prefer a condensed color palette for risk states to avoid alarm fatigue in the ops surface.
decisions: Use a right-rail floating overlay anchored to the cluster canvas instead of a full-page flow to reduce context switching.
Default cost annotations to 'estimated' when detailed telemetry is absent and surface data provenance on hover.
Expose a compact 'pin' affordance so operators can keep the Pathfinder visible during rollouts and upgrades.
Hide tenant-identifying metadata for consolidated views unless user has explicit 'view-tenant' permission.
